title: Sleep Duration Predicts Longevity Stronger Than Diet or Exercise, Study Finds
summary: A study from Oregon Health & Science University analyzing US county-level data from 2019–2025 found that insufficient sleep (less than seven hours per night) has a stronger association with lower life expectancy than diet and exercise. The research, published in Sleep Advances in 2025, suggests adeq
takeaways: Researchers analyzed county-level survey data from 2019–2025 across the US
Only smoking had a stronger association with life expectancy than insufficient sleep; obesity and diabetes also ranked above it
The study defined insufficient sleep as less than seven hours per night
American Academy of Sleep Medicine and Sleep Research Society recommend at least seven hours of sleep per night

title: Creatine Supplementation Increases Strength and Muscle Mass Even Without Exercise, Study Shows
summary: A 12-week randomized trial of 64 sedentary middle-aged adults found that creatine supplementation (10g daily) increased lean tissue mass and strength gains in participants who did not exercise, with even greater benefits when combined with exercise and diet changes. takeaways: 64 sedentary adults aged 45–65 randomized to 10g daily creatine or placebo for 12 weeks
Among 26 non-exercising participants, creatine increased lean tissue mass and bench press/leg press strength without resistance training

title: Leucine boosts cellular energy by protecting mitochondrial proteins
summary: Leucine protects key mitochondrial proteins from destruction, boosting cellular energy production and revealing a new link between nutrition and metabolism.

title: Study finds coffee influences mood and brain function via gut microbiota changes
summary: Research shows both caffeinated and decaf coffee reduce stress and depression while producing measurable changes in gut bacteria and metabolites.

title: Sodium bicarbonate and carbohydrate co-ingestion shown to enhance athletic performance
summary: Research highlights a performance advantage for athletes from combining sodium bicarbonate with carbohydrate supplementation.

title: Pomegranate-derived compound improves heart function by up to 80% in animal study
summary: Urolithin A, a compound produced after consuming pomegranates and walnuts, improved heart function measures by up to 80% in animal models of heart failure.

title: Vitamin C linked to fewer deaths in blood disorder clinical trial
summary: In a phase 2 trial of people with precancerous or low-risk blood cancers, daily vitamin C was linked to favorable inflammation changes and fewer serious complications.

title: Study Confirms Performance Benefit of Sodium Bicarbonate With Carbohydrate Co-Ingestion
summary: World Athletics-backed nutrition research shows that combining sodium bicarbonate with carbohydrates improves athletic performance.

title: Cutting ultra-processed food linked to depression symptom improvements
summary: A small preliminary study found that people with depression who dramatically reduced ultra-processed food intake experienced notable improvements in symptoms, possibly through reduced gut damage and inflammation.

title: Mulberry compounds reshape gut microbiome and influence metabolism
summary: Animal studies show mulberry compounds can alter gut bacteria in ways that support intestinal health and metabolism, though effects vary by plant part and processing method.

title: Gatorade launches multi-year research initiative on women's hydration science
summary: Gatorade commits to a multi-year research program addressing gaps in hydration science across different female life stages.

title: Research studies recruiting diet and exercise participants
summary: Multiple research initiatives are actively seeking study participants for diet and exercise research.
